description: This is a Java source file defining a utility class 'Log' for logging purposes, specifically tailored for Android development. It provides static methods for logging messages at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT) and manages a linked list of LogNode instances to handle log forwarding and chaining.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Helper class for managing and forwarding log messages through a chain of LogNode objects. It also provides constants for log levels.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be forwarded.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Forwards a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level, with optional Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with optional Throwable.
